library(stats)

#Global level Principal component analysis, Mahalanobis distance calculations, and Concentration-response analysis

test_chem_well <- read_csv(
  file.path(pipeline_output_path, "feature_results", "Well-level_data_simplified_categories.csv")
)
## New names:
## Rows: 384 Columns: 3328
## ── Column specification
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Delimiter: "," chr
## (1): ...1 dbl (3327): cells_Size_AreaShape, cells_Size_AreaShape.1, cells_Size_AreaShape.2, cells_Size_AreaShape.3, cells_Size_AreaShape.4, cells_Size_AreaShape.5,
## cells_Size_AreaShape.6,...
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data. ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
## • `` -> `...1`
# Move first column to row names
test_chem_well <- as.data.frame(test_chem_well)
rownames(test_chem_well) <- test_chem_well[[1]]
test_chem_well <- test_chem_well[, -1]

#Load in from sheet 2 so feature names are correct
well_data <- test_chem_well

#Principal component analysis (PCA)
pca <- prcomp(well_data, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

#Scree plot
scree_plot <- fviz_eig(pca, addlabels = T, ylim = c(0,75), main = paste0("Scree plot"))  
scree_plot

#Calculate the number of PCs that describe >95% variance
cumulative_prop <- cumsum(pca$sdev^2)/sum(pca$sdev^2)

#PC_90 <- length(which(cumulative_prop<0.90))+1
PC_95 <- length(which(cumulative_prop<0.95))+1
#PC_99 <- length(which(cumulative_prop<0.99))+1

#Rotation Matrix
a <- ncol(pca$rotation)

pca_x <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_x <- as.data.frame(cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), pca_x)) 

####SD >1
#pca_x <- pca$x[, pca$sdev > 1, drop = FALSE]

#pca_x <- as.data.frame(cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), pca_x)) 
####

ctrl_pc <- pca_x %>%
  filter(grepl(ctrl_group, chem))

ctrl_pc <- ctrl_pc[,-c(1)]

#DMSO_mean <- colMeans(DMSO_pc)
ctrl_mean <- apply(ctrl_pc, 2, mean)

dat <- as.matrix(well_data) %*% pca$rotation[,1:PC_95]
#dat <- pca$x[, 1:PC_95]

#Covariance Matrix
Cov <- cov(dat)

#Checkpoint
det(Cov)
## [1] 2.576528e+52
isSymmetric(Cov)
## [1] TRUE
solved_cov <- ginv(Cov)

#Mahalanobis distance determination

mahal_dist <- mahalanobis(dat, ctrl_mean, solved_cov, inverted = T) 
## Warning in sweep(x, 2L, center): STATS is longer than the extent of 'dim(x)[MARGIN]'
mahal_dist <- as.data.frame(mahal_dist)

mahal_dist_sq <- sqrt(mahal_dist)
mahal_dist <- mahal_dist_sq

mahal_dist <- cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), mahal_dist)

sample <- as.data.frame(mahal_dist$chem)
colnames(sample) <- "sample"

sample <- tibble(sample) %>%
  separate(sample, c("chem", "concentration", "Well", "Plate"), sep = "_", remove = T)

mahal_dist <- cbind(sample, mahal_dist = mahal_dist$mahal_dist)

mahal_dist$concentration <- as.numeric(mahal_dist$concentration)

mahal_dist <- mahal_dist %>%
  group_by(chem) %>%
  mutate(conc_count = length(unique(concentration)))

mahal_ctrl <- mahal_dist %>%
  filter(chem == ctrl_group)

mahal_dist <- mahal_dist %>%
  filter(conc_count > 3) 

mahal_dist <- rbind(mahal_dist, mahal_ctrl)

mahal_dist$exp <- exp_name

#Plot Malanobis distance

chem_list <- unique(mahal_dist$chem)
plate <- unique(mahal_dist$Plate)

mahal_dist[mahal_dist$chem == ctrl_group, ]$concentration <- 1


lapply(plate, function(plate_i) {

  p <- ggplot(mahal_dist[mahal_dist$Plate == plate_i, ], 
              aes(x = concentration, y = mahal_dist, colour = chem)) +

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +

    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

#  ggsave(
 #   filename = file.path(plots, paste0("Plate_", plate_i, "_Global_Mahalanobis.png")), plot = p,width = 50, height = 35, units = "cm")

  p
})

#tcplfit2

test_chem_res <- mahal_dist %>%
  filter(chem !=ctrl_group)

#####Tcplfit2 to derive benchmark concentrations#####

chem_list <- unique(test_chem_res$chem)

DMSO_dist <- mahal_dist %>%
  filter(chem == ctrl_group)

vehicle_ctrl <- mahal_dist %>%
  filter(chem == ctrl_group) %>%
  summarise(Median = median(mahal_dist, na.rm=T), 
            nMad = mad(mahal_dist, constant=1.4826, na.rm=T))

#Function to model concentration-response using concRespCore of tcplfit2
conc_res_modeling <- function(test_chem, vehicle_ctrl){ 
  
  row <- list(conc = as.numeric(test_chem$concentration),
              resp = test_chem$mahal_dist,
              bmed = vehicle_ctrl$Median,
              cutoff = vehicle_ctrl$nMad,
              onesd = vehicle_ctrl$nMad,
              name = paste0(test_chem$chem[1]),
              assay = "Mahalanobis distance (cutoff = 1)")
  
  concRespCore(row, conthits = TRUE, aicc = FALSE, force.fit = FALSE,  bidirectional = TRUE,
               fitmodels=c("cnst", "hill", "poly1", "poly2", "pow", "exp2", "exp3","exp4", "exp5"))
  
}




#Model concentration-response for each chemical and plot individually  
tcpl_results <- lapply(chem_list, function(x){
  chem_data <- test_chem_res %>%
    filter(chem == x)
  tcpl_chem <- conc_res_modeling(chem_data, vehicle_ctrl)
  
  if(tcpl_chem$hitcall > 0.9){
   # png(file = paste0(plots, "_tcplfit_curves.png"))
    concRespPlot(tcpl_chem, ymin=min(chem_data$mahal_dist)-5, ymax=max(chem_data$mahal_dist)+10, draw.error.arrows = FALSE)
    # dev.off()
  }
  
  tcpl_chem
}) %>%
      do.call(rbind, .)

tcpl_testchem <- tcpl_results %>%
  mutate(
    minDose = min(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxDose = max(conc, na.rm = TRUE),

    removal_reason = case_when(
      hitcall < 0.9            ~ "low_hitcall",
      is.na(bmdl)              ~ "missing_bmdl",
      is.na(bmdu)              ~ "missing_bmdu",
     # bmd < minDose            ~ "bmd_below_minDose",
      #bmd > maxDose            ~ "bmd_above_maxDose",
      TRUE                     ~ "kept"
    ),

    keep = removal_reason == "kept",

    bmd  = ifelse(keep, bmd, NA),
    bmdl = ifelse(keep, bmdl, NA),
    bmdu = ifelse(keep, bmdu, NA)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plots, "Global_BMC__sqrt.png"),
  plot = ggplot(tcpl_testchem, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    xlab("Median Best BMC (1 MAD above vehicle control) \u03BCM") +
    ylab("Chemicals"),
  width = 40,
  height = 20,
  units = "cm"
)

Global PCA, Mahalanobis distances, and BMD — All feature sets

# Discover all Well-level simplified CSV files produced by sheet 2
simplified_files <- list.files(
  file.path(pipeline_output_path, "feature_results"),
  pattern = "^Well-level_data_simplified_categories.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

message("Found ", length(simplified_files), " feature-set files to process.")
## Found 7 feature-set files to process.
walk(simplified_files, function(path) {

  # --- Label for output file names ---
  file_label <- basename(path) |>
    stringr::str_remove("^Well-level_data_simplified_categories") |>
    stringr::str_remove("\\.csv$")

  if (file_label == "") file_label <- "_all_features"

  message("\n=== Processing: ", basename(path), " ===")

  # --- Load data ---
  well_data <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(well_data) <- well_data[[1]]
  well_data <- well_data[, -1]

  # --- PCA ---
  pca <- prcomp(well_data, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

  scree_plot <- fviz_eig(
    pca, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 75),
    main = paste0("Scree plot — ", file_label)
  )
  #ggsave(
   # filename = file.path(plots, paste0("Scree", file_label, ".png")),
   # plot = scree_plot, width = 20, height = 12, units = "cm"
 # )

  # Number of PCs explaining >95% variance
  cumulative_prop <- cumsum(pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  PC_95 <- length(which(cumulative_prop < 0.95)) + 1

  pca_x <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
  pca_x <- as.data.frame(cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), pca_x))

  ctrl_pc <- pca_x |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl(ctrl_group, chem))
  ctrl_pc  <- ctrl_pc[, -1]
  ctrl_mean <- apply(ctrl_pc, 2, mean)

  dat <- as.matrix(well_data) %*% pca$rotation[, 1:PC_95]
  Cov <- cov(dat)
  solved_cov <- MASS::ginv(Cov)

  # --- Mahalanobis distances ---
  mahal_dist_raw <- mahalanobis(dat, ctrl_mean[1:PC_95], solved_cov, inverted = TRUE)
  mahal_dist_df  <- as.data.frame(sqrt(mahal_dist_raw))
  colnames(mahal_dist_df) <- "mahal_dist"

  mahal_dist_df <- cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), mahal_dist_df)

  sample <- tibble(sample = as.character(mahal_dist_df$chem)) |>
    tidyr::separate(sample, c("chem", "concentration", "Well", "Plate"),
                    sep = "_", remove = TRUE)

  mahal_dist_df <- cbind(sample, mahal_dist = mahal_dist_df$mahal_dist)
  mahal_dist_df$concentration <- as.numeric(mahal_dist_df$concentration)

  mahal_dist_df <- mahal_dist_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(chem) |>
    dplyr::mutate(conc_count = length(unique(concentration)))

  mahal_ctrl_i <- mahal_dist_df |> dplyr::filter(chem == ctrl_group)

  mahal_dist_df <- mahal_dist_df |>
    dplyr::filter(conc_count > 3) |>
    rbind(mahal_ctrl_i)

  mahal_dist_df[mahal_dist_df$chem == ctrl_group, ]$concentration <- 1
  mahal_dist_df$exp <- exp_name

  # --- Per-plate Mahalanobis plots ---
  lapply(unique(mahal_dist_df$Plate), function(plate_i) {
    p <- ggplot(
      mahal_dist_df[mahal_dist_df$Plate == plate_i, ],
      aes(x = concentration, y = mahal_dist, colour = chem)
    ) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "maroon4") +
      geom_ribbon(
        aes(ymin = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) - mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
            ymax = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) + mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist)),
        fill = "thistle3", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5
      ) +
      scale_x_log10() +
      xlab("Concentration (\u03BCM)") + ylab("Mahalanobis Distance") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 15)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(r = 15)),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)
      ) +
      facet_wrap(vars(chem), scales = "free") +
      theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Plate ", plate_i, file_label))

    # ggsave(
    #   filename = file.path(
    #     plots, paste0("Plate_", plate_i, file_label, "_Global_Mahalanobis.png")
    #   ),
    #   plot = p, width = 50, height = 35, units = "cm"
    # )
  })

  # --- Global Mahalanobis plot ---
  p_global <- ggplot(mahal_dist_df,
                     aes(x = concentration, y = mahal_dist, colour = chem)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "maroon4") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) - mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
          ymax = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) + mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist)),
      fill = "thistle3", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    xlab("Concentration (\u03BCM)") + ylab("Mahalanobis Distance") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(vars(chem), scales = "free") +
    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
    ggtitle(paste0(exp_name, file_label))

  # ggsave(
  #   filename = file.path(plots, paste0(exp_name, file_label, "_Global_Mahalanobis.png")),
  #   plot = p_global, width = 50, height = 35, units = "cm"
  # )

  # --- tcplfit2 concentration-response & BMD ---
  test_chem_res_i <- mahal_dist_df |> dplyr::filter(chem != ctrl_group)
  chem_list_i     <- unique(test_chem_res_i$chem)

  vehicle_ctrl_i <- mahal_dist_df |>
    dplyr::filter(chem == ctrl_group) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Median = median(mahal_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
      nMad   = mad(mahal_dist, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  conc_res_modeling_i <- function(test_chem, vc) {
    row <- list(
      conc   = as.numeric(test_chem$concentration),
      resp   = test_chem$mahal_dist,
      bmed   = vc$Median,
      cutoff = vc$nMad,
      onesd  = vc$nMad,
      name   = paste0(test_chem$chem[1]),
      assay  = "Mahalanobis distance (cutoff = 1)"
    )
    tcplfit2::concRespCore(
      row, conthits = TRUE, aicc = FALSE, force.fit = FALSE,
      bidirectional = TRUE,
      fitmodels = c("cnst", "hill", "poly1", "poly2", "pow",
                    "exp2", "exp3", "exp4", "exp5")
    )
  }

  tcpl_results_i <- lapply(chem_list_i, function(x) {
    chem_data <- test_chem_res_i |> dplyr::filter(chem == x)
    tcpl_chem  <- conc_res_modeling_i(chem_data, vehicle_ctrl_i)

    # if (!is.null(tcpl_chem$hitcall) && tcpl_chem$hitcall > 0.9) {
    #   png(file = file.path(
    #     plots, paste0(x, file_label, "_tcplfit_curves.png")
    #   ))
    #   tcplfit2::concRespPlot(
    #     tcpl_chem,
    #     ymin = min(chem_data$mahal_dist) - 5,
    #     ymax = max(chem_data$mahal_dist) + 10,
    #     draw.error.arrows = FALSE
    #   )
    #   dev.off()
    # }
    tcpl_chem
  }) |> do.call(rbind, args = _)

  tcpl_testchem_i <- tcpl_results_i |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      minDose = min(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      maxDose = max(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      removal_reason = dplyr::case_when(
        hitcall < 0.9   ~ "low_hitcall",
        is.na(bmdl)     ~ "missing_bmdl",
        is.na(bmdu)     ~ "missing_bmdu",
        TRUE            ~ "kept"
      ),
      keep = removal_reason == "kept",
      bmd  = ifelse(keep, bmd,  NA),
      bmdl = ifelse(keep, bmdl, NA),
      bmdu = ifelse(keep, bmdu, NA),
      exp_name = exp_name
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # --- BMD plot ---
  bmd_plot <- ggplot(tcpl_testchem_i,
                     aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 6,  colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
      strip.text.x  = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      panel.border  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    xlab("Median Best BMC (1 MAD above vehicle control) \u03BCM") +
    ylab("Chemicals") +
    ggtitle(paste0("BMD — ", file_label))

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plots, paste0("Global_BMC", file_label, ".png")),
    plot = bmd_plot, width = 40, height = 20, units = "cm"
  )

  # --- Save tcpl results table ---
write.csv(
  tcpl_testchem_i,
  file.path(
    pipeline_output_path,
    "tcplfit_results",
    paste0("tcpl_results", file_label, ".csv")
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
  message("Done: ", basename(path))
})
